n26b82ec109.headline: NG Investeeringud Profit Rose 9.2 Percent to 34 Million Euros
n26b82ec109.summary: Estonian company NG Investeeringud increased turnover by 6.1% to 873 million euros and net profit grew 9.2% to 34.1 million euros over the year.
n26b82ec109.why: NG Investeeringud is a major Estonian investment group and majority owner of Tallinna Kaubamaja, making its financial performance a key indicator of regional retail and investment trends.
